newsitem.title: USA: Conrail says apparent defeat no surprise.
newsitem.headline: Conrail says apparent defeat no surprise.

text.p: Conrail Inc said Friday it was not surprised that its shareholders had apparently rejected a measure crucial to its merger agreement with CSX Corp.
In a statement, Conrail Chairman David LeVan also said the vote "has no implications as to how our shareholders will ultimately decide on the CSX merger."
Conrail cited a proposal unveiled earlier this week by Norfolk Southern in which it proposed buying 9.9 percent of Conrail shares if the vote were defeated.
"Norfolk knew that our shareholders would support the CSX transaction and made this enticing offer solely to undermine this vote," LeVan said.
Conrail also said that preliminary tabulations on the vote will be provided to both sides over the weekend and a final tally will be made shortly after that.
